scope: Read-only mechanical source/evidence selections; root owns staging and transport. User requested fan-prototype publication; rights-policy facts are documented separately.

minimalGit.includes: Buildable app source/runtime art, canonical scripts/prompts/manifests and final H JSON evidence; curated website PNGs must be added separately. Raw PNG restoration is required for full RGBA audit if originals are archived separately.

withCanonicalOriginals.benefit: Keeps the full independent PNG↔WebP audit runnable offline; archives intermediate/staged/rejected/native bulk outside Git.

guestRuntimeSubset.status: Owner-requested fan prototype; Riot identities remain third-party IP, with authorization not independently verified.

externalArchiveContents: Intermediate APK candidates E/F/G and R8 mappings
Rejected/staged generation outputs and historical metadata snapshots
Repeated observer/source snapshots and full native capture sets
Canonical originals only if choosing minimalGit instead of withCanonicalOriginals
archiveRequirements: No local evidence deletion. Preserve exact bytes and original relative paths.
Include SHA256, byte size, identity and original location for each archived file.
Commit a small archive-index.json with actual durable URI + archive SHA before claiming public reproducibility; a missing upload is not a preserved public archive.
Keep final H failure/scope notes in Git and distinguish earlier E/G failures.

offlineIntegrityAuditReadyGit.includes: Canonical PNGs, pre-bounds metadata, exactly referenced superseded PNGs, explicit G rig applied receipt and its archived before JSONs. Avoid all intermediate mappings/APKs/repeated capture sets.
offlineIntegrityAuditReadyGit.status: Mechanical selection only. User requested fan-prototype publication; Riot policy and unverified authorization are documented separately.
